summary: The diff implements FR-001..FR-030 and the five user stories faithfully against spec.md/plan.md/data-model.md (intake routing, brainstorm stage, skill resolution and precedence, protected seam confirmation, widened UI detection, and the aligned documents/canonical render), with two task-completion evidence gaps in the commit trail.

findings.summary: T003's own red-proof work (write the three throwaway Seam 3 fixtures, run the contract assertion, record the red result) has no commit evidence, yet tasks.md checks it done.
findings.evidence: tasks.md T003: 'Write the three throwaway pending fixtures and run the contract assertion from quickstart.md §Seam 3; record the red result... (FR-006, FR-017, SC-008)'. The only commit that flips T003 from `[ ]` to `[X]` is f3fe13aa4b9e2ab53619bc6f5b6a476f0790e41e, titled 'T002 Seam 2 red proof', whose body documents and red-proofs only Seam 2 ('Red: Seam 2 link assertion failed as expected') and never mentions Seam 3, the fixtures, or a second red result. T003 carries no `Exempt:` tag in tasks.md, so ENG-2's red-proof requirement applies and is unmet (engineering.md, 'Red proof'; ENG-1..ENG-5 keep full enforcement per findings.md).
findings.fix: Either give T003 its own commit carrying `Red: Seam 3 contract assertion failed as expected` (or the applicable form) and a description of the fixtures/assertion run, or amend the existing commit's body to add that second Red line and description before the task is marked done.

findings.summary: T022 is checked done in tasks.md, but its defined work -- running manual checks 1-6 -- was not performed; all six were recorded as deferred next steps instead of run results.
findings.evidence: tasks.md T022: 'Run the six manual agent-driven checks 1-6 in quickstart.md ... and report their results separately ... (SC-001..SC-007)'. The commit's own manual-checks.md states checks 1-6 are 'Deferred -- needs a live /factory run with a real user' and lists them as 'next steps before this feature is considered fully validated', i.e. not run. SC-001..SC-008 (intake routing correctness, zero-write pause/resume, seam-confirmation timing, missing-skill stop, UI-detection accuracy) therefore remain unverified by any agent-driven run, while the task that was supposed to perform that verification is marked complete.
findings.fix: Either leave T022 unchecked until a live /factory run exercises checks 1-6 and their actual results are recorded, or split the task so the deferral itself (with its own completion criteria) is what tasks.md marks done, matching what quickstart.md and DESIGN.md's validation plan actually ask for.
